_instructions: Approved deployment manifest for Polygon PoS. Replace every placeholder address before deployment: `admin` MUST be the dedicated production Safe (a deployed contract), `managers`/`emergencyLockers` MUST be non-zero, unique, strictly ascending, and 1-10 entries each. DeployVault.s.sol reads this file, validates it, and writes the deployment record into `.deployment`. Managers must be direct EOAs; any contract manager must be listed in `auditedForwarders`. Managers and emergencyLockers must be disjoint unless `allowManagerLockerOverlap` is true (requires explicit threat-model approval).
